prompt.en: Two equal 56 µF capacitors are connected in series. What is the total capacitance?

explanation.en: Two equal capacitors in series have half the capacitance of one.

prompt.en: Which part is useful when you want high opposition to RF but low opposition at low frequency?

text.en: A bypass capacitor chosen to shunt RF to ground.
An inductor used as an RF choke.
A small capacitor placed in the audio path.
A resistor chosen for a DC voltage drop.

explanation.en: Inductive reactance increases with frequency, so a choke can impede RF.

prompt.en: Which statement is true at resonance in a series RLC circuit?

text.en: The L and C reactances cancel, so current is at a maximum.
The circuit behaves like a parallel tuned trap with high impedance.
Adding more capacitance would have no effect on tuning.

explanation.en: Series resonance gives low impedance at the resonant frequency, so current is highest.
